## Scientific publishing, open access and research integrity

### IA na redação científica: ética, regras editoriais e boas práticas de reporte {#ia-escrita-cientifica}

*Upcoming · October 2026 · annual meeting of the Graduate Programme in Animal Biology
· 40 min · in Portuguese*

Where generative AI stands in the writing of a scientific paper: authorship
and responsibility, the policies of the five largest publishers plus Cambridge
and OUP, Brazil's CNPq Ordinance nº 2.664/2026, COPE's position, the known
limits of LLMs, and the AIdIT framework for reporting AI use. Every quoted
policy comes from the publisher's own page; the deck closes with its own AI
use declaration.

[{{< fa solid display >}} Open the slides](https://provetelab.org/ia-escrita-cientifica/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
&nbsp;
[{{< fa brands github >}} Source](https://github.com/diogoprov/ia-escrita-cientifica){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

### Boas práticas para redação e submissão de artigos {#wiley-redacao}

*2025 · Wiley Customer Education · in Portuguese*

What editors and reviewers actually look for, from choosing a journal to
responding to a decision letter — aimed at graduate students and early-career
researchers publishing in English as a second language.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF)](talks/2025-wiley-boas-praticas-redacao.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Acesso aberto e seus benefícios {#wiley-acesso-aberto}

*2025 · Wiley Customer Education · in Portuguese*

Routes to open access, what transformative agreements do and do not cover, and
what the choice means in practice for a researcher based in the Global South.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF)](talks/2025-wiley-acesso-aberto.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Equity in open access publishing {#alspp-equity}

*2024 · Panel — Association of Learned and Professional Society Publishers (ALPSP)*

Invited panellist. Article processing charges as a barrier that moves the
paywall from reading to publishing, and what waiver schemes miss when the
constraint is institutional rather than individual.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF)](talks/2024-alpsp-equity-open-access.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Community ecology and evolution

### Processos neutros e baseados no nicho em comunidades {#nicho-neutro}

*Workshop of Community Ecology, UNESP/IBILCE · 1st edition, 9–14 April 2018;
[2020 online edition](https://simposioecologiaco.wixsite.com/site),
31 August – 5 September 2020. Later revised and taught as a lecture in the
graduate course "Ecologia de interações" · in Portuguese*

Niche theory and neutral theory as competing — and partly reconcilable —
accounts of community assembly: the concepts of community, resources and
conditions; modern coexistence theory; the niche concept from Grinnell and
Elton to Hutchinson, and its main criticisms; the structure and limits of
neutral models; and the attempts to integrate the two.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF, 101 pp.)](talks/2018-nicho-teoria-neutra.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
